mapper.select: select group_concat(t.IND_ID,',') uniteIndId, t.UNITE_ID uniteId, t.REMARK remark from RSK_INDIVID_UNITE t where t.UNITE_ID in (select UNITE_ID from RSK_INDIVID_UNITE where PRT_BAG_ID=#{prtBagId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and IND_ID=#{indId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and t.IND_ID!=#{indId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by t.UNITE_ID,t.REMARK
